properties.content: Question: phil mickelson diet and exercise Answer: Phil Mickelson has employed a combination of intermittent fasting and targeted exercise routines to manage his weight and improve his golf game. He has spoken about using a six-day fast, including a special coffee blend, to reset his body and aid in weight loss. His exercise program focuses on core strength, multi-plane movements, and power training to enhance his golf swing and overall athletic performance. Diet:: - Intermittent Fasting: Mickelson has utilized intermittent fasting, sometimes for up to five days without food, to lose weight and potentially reduce inflammation related to his psoriatic arthritis. He also practices shorter fasts, like 36-hour fasts, during the week. - Special Coffee Blend: He has a specific coffee blend for his fasts, which includes Ethiopian beans, MCT oil, collagen protein powder, Himalayan pink salt, almond milk, L-theanine, Manuka honey, and cinnamon. - Dietary Awareness: Mickelson has become more aware of the impact of his diet on his body, including reducing sugar intake and eliminating things like diet soda. - Focus on Inflammation: He has spoken about the importance of diet in managing inflammation related to his psoriatic arthritis. This video discusses the ingredients in Phil Mickelson's coffee blend during his fasting periods: Exercise:: - Core Strength: Mickelson's exercise program emphasizes core strength, as it's crucial for generating power in a golf swing. - Multi-Plane Movements: Exercises are designed to mimic the movements in a golf swing, including lateral, rotational, and vertical movements. - Power Training: He incorporates exercises like medicine ball rotational throws and box jumps to improve his power and explosiveness. - Speed and Light Resistance: Mickelson focuses on speed and light resistance during power training exercises. - Joint Integrity: He also does exercises to maintain the strength and function of his joints, particularly his pelvis and shoulders. - Warm-up and Cool-down: Mickelson begins his workouts with foam rolling, static stretching, and dynamic warm-up exercises, and finishes with cool-down routines. - Four Days a Week: Mickelson works with his trainer four days a week for approximately 75 minutes each session.
